title: Kick off the interaction inventory before the next milestone?
question: A standing follow-up from the movement-scheme ruling: enumerate every interaction in the game, phase by phase, and match each to its best input method — touch as primary, with desktop mappings. The agreement was 'first pass before M3, re-audit at each phase's design start.' M3 planning is now next in line, so the bill is due.
why_now: This is a scheduling call, not a design one: green-light the first pass now so it feeds M3 planning, or explicitly fold it into M3's own plan.

options.label: Green-light it now
options.detail: A drafted inventory lands in the UX doc for your review before M3 scope is set.

options.label: Fold it into M3 planning
options.detail: It becomes a work item inside the M3 plan rather than a precursor.

options.label: Defer it
options.detail: Say why in the judgment box so the record shows it was chosen, not forgotten.

links.label: M3 planning in the program report
